how_to_apply: The notice asks for applications by email and through a Google Form:
Fill the application form printed in the notice (given in English and Hindi) completely. The form asks for the applicant's name, age, gender, email ID, permanent address and two contact numbers.
Fill in the form's academic section: year of passing post graduation, number of attempts in post graduation, and the aggregate of all years' post graduation marks (%).
Write the research experience in brief (project name, job duration and nature of work), and add any awards.
Combine the completed application form with your detailed CV and research experience into a single PDF file.
E-mail the single PDF file to [email protected].
In addition, fill the Google Form at https://forms.gle/tJGQTGwqpEGzobGX6. The Hindi version of the notice states that filling this form is mandatory.
Complete both steps by 7 November 2026. Applications submitted after that date will not be considered.
The notice does not name a subject line for the email.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications will not be entertained. Applications received after the closing date and time will not be entertained. The application form, CV and research experience must be sent as one single PDF file, not as separate attachments. The decision of the competent authority on all matters is final and binding on applicants. This covers acceptance or rejection of an application, the eligibility or suitability of applicants, and the mode and criteria for selection.

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS New Delhi
content_sections.text: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences is located at Ansari Nagar, New Delhi – 110029. This post serves a research project in the Institute's Department of Oral Pathology And Microbiology at CDER, which is building a point of care, Artificial Intelligence-based screening tool for oral cancer. The project carries the code T-331 and is funded by the Ministry of Education, Government of India.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited from Indian citizens only. The educational qualification printed for the post is given below. A degree holder in any subject qualifies without a stated experience requirement. The 2 years experience applies only to a candidate applying on the basis of a diploma. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of the post.

rows.qualification_required: Any degree (or Diploma with 2 years experience)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: The notice asks for applications by email and through a Google Form: Fill the application form printed in the notice (given in English and Hindi) completely. The form asks for the applicant's name, age, gender, email ID, permanent address and two contact numbers. Fill in the form's academic section: year of passing post graduation, number of attempts in post graduation, and the aggregate of all years' post graduation marks (%). Write the research experience in brief (project name, job duration and nature of work), and add any awards. Combine the completed application form with your detailed CV and research experience into a single PDF file. E-mail the single PDF file to [email protected] . In addition, fill the Google Form at https://forms.gle/tJGQTGwqpEGzobGX6 . The Hindi version of the notice states that filling this form is mandatory. Complete both steps by 7 November 2026. Applications submitted after that date will not be considered. The notice does not name a subject line for the email.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview through email. No TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview. Applicants must bring all original documents at the time of the interview. The interview date and venue are not specified in the notice.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications will not be entertained. Applications received after the closing date and time will not be entertained. The application form, CV and research experience must be sent as one single PDF file, not as separate attachments. The decision of the competent authority on all matters is final and binding on applicants. This covers acceptance or rejection of an application, the eligibility or suitability of applicants, and the mode and criteria for selection.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS New Delhi Field Investigator/Data Collector post?
faq.answer: The last date for application submission is 7 November 2026. Applications submitted after that date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for the Field Investigator/Data Collector (State/Dist) post?
faq.answer: The required qualification is any degree, or a diploma with 2 years experience.

faq.question: Q3. Can diploma holders apply for this AIIMS project post?
faq.answer: Yes. Diploma holders can apply if they have 2 years experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the AIIMS Field Investigator/Data Collector post?
faq.answer: The post carries a consolidated pay of Rs. 54,470/-.
